w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🩸 The Redactor mauled Ella (-88 health) over 3 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing. — staying out of sight for the rest of the day — too hurt to meet it again

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: They argued over names for 4 beasts — 4 words, 4 debates: "Big Big" (2), "Old Gavel" (2), "Captain Bright-Eyes" (2), "Loud-Eyes" (2).

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: It's settled. The village is calling it "Big Ugly." The Codex keeps it.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (13/9/6), with 6 wave-4 fought, 8 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 4 · Forage 12 · Craft 2 · Talk 16 · Explore 32 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE WITNESS — "Offer them a way back."
◈ THE ARCHITECT — Yuki Mori ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,100 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.
